context7.description: Live documentation lookup — HuggingFace, PyTorch, LangChain, and any library docs via resolve-library-id and query-docs.

exa-web-search.description: Neural web search via Exa — broader research after GitHub search and context7.

keenable.description: Agent-oriented web search. Works anonymously (1000 req/hour per IP); add header X-API-Key: keen_<key> to lift the hourly cap. search_web_pages supports snippet_max_length; fetch_page_content takes a prompt for LLM extraction instead of the whole page.

parallel.description: Top of the Artificial Analysis agentic-search index. Works anonymously at lower rate limits; Authorization: Bearer <key> raises them. Returns large excerpt payloads (~28k chars per search) with no size knob.
